ports.note: Points in, a keyed table of periods out, so a Table output can display the series and a Chart output can draw it as a curve. The time axis needs no new port type: the dates are already attributes of the input.

ontology.note: fw:CaseSeries is declared disjoint from fw:PointDataset, and fw:CaseSeriesShape requires the kind of date and the period, so a series that does not say what it is a series of cannot conform. Verified in tests; this registry version records application validation only.

changes.description: Counts cases per day, week or month from a declared date attribute and a declared kind of date, optionally weighted by an attribute where one record stands for several cases. Zero-count periods are retained and records without an ISO 8601 date are excluded and counted. The first widget on the time axis; see docs/experiments/61-input-dimensions.md.

evidence.note: Unit checks cover weighted versus unweighted totals, retained empty periods, Monday-based weeks and month grouping, the required kind of date, refusal to parse a non-ISO date, and refusal of a non-numeric or negative weight. It counts what it is told to count: nothing here establishes that the declared weight really is a case count or that the dates are accurate.
